theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_isMinimizingIn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), IsMinimizingIn T A → IsMinimizingIn (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') (dilation x lam '' A)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
